name: credicobranza-monorepo
description: Sistema de Gestion de Prestamos y Cobranza - Fullstack

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev:local: npm run docker:db && concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev:backend:local" "npm run dev:frontend:local"
scripts.dev:backend:local: cd backend && DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5433 DB_SCHEMA_MODE=alter npm run dev
scripts.dev:frontend:local: cd frontend && VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5000 npm run dev
scripts.db:reset-local: cd backend && DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5433 DB_SCHEMA_RESET_ALLOWED=true npm run db:reset-local
scripts.seed:local-users: cd backend && DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5433 RESET_QA_CREDENTIALS_CONFIRM=RESET_RAILWAY_QA_CREDENTIALS QA_PASSWORD=Admin123! node scripts/resetQaCredentials.js
scripts.smoke:local: cd backend && SMOKE_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5000 npm run smoke:local
scripts.docker:db: cd backend && docker compose up db -d
scripts.docker:dev: cd backend && docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
